Subject: ergodic theory | ID: 22749

Step 3. The continuous functional \(\Phi_{01310013}\) on the Frechet space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01310013}\| \leq C_01310013\) by the continuous embedding theorem.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the variational convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
